titleJa: うどんこ病（キュウリ）の外観例
altJa: 緑色のキュウリの葉に、白っぽい粉状の不規則な部分が広がるイラスト。葉全体の輪郭と葉脈、白い部分の間に残る緑色が見えます。
observationJa: 葉の形と葉脈を確認し、表面の白っぽい部分の形、広がり方、残る緑色との位置関係を見ます。白い色だけで判断しません。
limitJa: うどんこ病と関連付けた外観の一例です。似た白い付着や変色には別の原因もあり、他の症状と重なる場合があります。この図だけで病名を確定せず、実物の追加観察や確認が必要です。治療・農薬の選択や食用の可否を判定する図ではありません。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE original gentle botanical 2D painted illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app: a single whole green cucumber leaf bearing irregular whitish powder-like surface patches, an appearance example associated with powdery mildew. Show the entire broad angular shallowly lobed cucumber leaf outline, serrated edge, palmately branching green veins and short naturally attached petiole. Several irregular diffuse-edged whitish powdery-looking patches lie on the upper leaf surface, some merging, with substantial green leaf visible between them; patches cross surface areas rather than forming a regular repeated dot pattern. Keep the leaf outline and vein context legible, no separate powder pile, no white flowers, no water droplets, no dense mold fluff. Flat botanical atlas view, leaf centered with generous warm ivory margins, gentle watercolor/gouache 2D educational style, softly textured green and muted white, not a photograph or glossy render. No microscopic spores, magnification inset, roots, soil, fruit, treatment equipment, pesticide, hands, extra plant scene, arrows or comparison panels. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. This is a limited visual symptom example, not a diagnostic certificate. Original composition with no reference images and no copying any textbook photograph composition.
